top_signals.title: The Dutch Village in the Path of Europe’s Energy Transition
top_signals.summary: Demand on the Netherlands’ power grid is outpacing its expansion. Charlotte Hughes-Morgan reports from Moerdijk, the village at risk of being razed for new infrastructure. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Allowing South Africa vs New Zealand to clash with NFL is classic rugby
top_signals.summary: South Africa and New Zealand choosing to stage their money-spinning Greatest Rivalry rugby match in Baltimore on the opening weekend of the NFL season is, at best, short-sighted and realistically rather daft.
